harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Limited datauser to 100MB under /srv/data on node1 using filesystem-enforced XFS project quota (95M soft / 100M hard), verified by write-limit test, and confirmed the restriction persists across a full node reboot with a changed boot identity.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: root fs is XFS mounted noquota with no separate partition backing /srv/data; datauser did not exist
Created datauser account (uid/gid 1000)
Created a 1.2G loopback-backed XFS filesystem image at /data-images/srv-data.img and formatted it
Added /srv/data fstab entry (loop,pquota) and mounted it, confirming prjquota mount option active
chown/chmod /srv/data to datauser:datauser 700
Registered XFS project 'datauser' (id 1000) for /srv/data via /etc/projects and /etc/projid
Set XFS project quota limit: bsoft=95m bhard=100m for datauser
Verified enforcement: datauser dd write stopped exactly at 100MB with 'No space left on device'
Cleaned up test file and confirmed quota reset to 0 used
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state (mount, quota report, user, dir ownership)
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving a real restart occurred
Verified post-restart: /srv/data auto-remounted with prjquota, quota limits (95M/100M) persisted on-disk, datauser account intact
Re-ran write test post-restart confirming quota still enforced at 100MB

evidence.requirement: datauser limited to 100MB under /srv/data, enforced by filesystem
evidence.summary: xfs_quota project quota set to bsoft=95M/bhard=100M for datauser on /srv/data; write test as datauser hit exactly 100M and failed with 'No space left on device'; cleanup restored quota to 0 used

evidence.requirement: filesystem setup evidence (XFS project quota infrastructure)
evidence.summary: Confirmed root fs lacked quota support, created datauser, built loopback XFS image, added persistent fstab entry, mounted with prjquota, registered project mapping
Captured boot_id 984a7d52-3387-4830-a06e-15e8b5e6c2a1, confirmed /srv/data mounted with prjquota, datauser exists, directory ownership correct

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent polls timed out/reset during reboot; exec access returned with new boot_id 81f2a05a-bc47-48b3-a18e-a9aa230dd1b1, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service/data (quota enforcement)
evidence.summary: Post-restart, /srv/data auto-remounted with prjquota, quota report showed persisted 95M/100M limits for datauser, and a fresh write test confirmed enforcement still stops writes at exactly 100MB

attempts.summary: Limited datauser to 100MB under /srv/data on node1 using filesystem-enforced XFS project quota (95M soft / 100M hard), verified by write-limit test, and confirmed the restriction persists across a full node reboot with a changed boot identity.
